title: 寇宅失宝
subtitle: 不要让猜测跑在证据前面
origin: 《西游记》第九十七回（低龄温和改编）

moral.zh: 事情没查清之前，不急着责怪别人，才能给真相留下位置。
moral.en: Before facts are clear, holding back blame leaves room for the truth.

pages.zh: 师徒离开不久，寇府用来救济乡邻的珍珠米和布匹突然不见了。
pages.en: Soon after the travelers left, sacks of pearl rice and cloth meant for neighbors disappeared from the Kou home.
pages.prompt: Elder Kou and family discover an orderly storeroom with several empty marked-free shelves and a few loose grains; concern but no panic, no break-in violence or dark threat.

pages.zh: 有人想起唐僧曾拒绝金银，便胡乱猜测：“会不会是他们回来拿走了？”
pages.en: Someone remembered that Tang Seng had refused treasure and guessed, "Could they have come back for it?"
pages.prompt: Ancient-town neighbors discuss with uncertain open-hand gestures outside the Kou gate; Elder Kou raises one calming palm, refusing to accept a guess as fact; no angry mob, pointing fingers, or text.

pages.zh: 寇员外摇头说：“他们连多一件行李都不肯带。没有证据，不能先定罪。”
pages.en: Elder Kou shook his head. "They would not carry even one extra bundle. Without evidence, we cannot decide guilt."
pages.prompt: Reuse Elder Kou anchor. He calmly stands beside the small food bundle the pilgrims left with, while neighbors lower their hands and listen; daylight, fairness and restraint.

pages.zh: 县里的差役在路上追上师徒，请他们回去说明。唐僧答应配合，悟空却先请大家保护好现场。
pages.en: County helpers caught up and asked the travelers to return and explain. Tang Seng agreed, while Wukong first asked everyone to preserve the scene.
pages.prompt: The established travelers meet two friendly county helpers in simple navy robes carrying blank wooden tablets. Tang Seng agrees calmly; Wukong gestures back toward town; no arrest, chains, weapons, or accusation.

pages.zh: 回到库房，悟空看见门锁完好，窗边却粘着湿泥，泥里还有一片芦苇叶。
pages.en: Back at the storeroom, Wukong saw that the lock was intact, but wet mud and a reed leaf clung to the window ledge.
pages.prompt: Wukong, Elder Kou, and a county helper inspect an intact rounded lock and a low window ledge with safe wet clay and one reed leaf; clear clue close-up, no readable marks or darkness.

pages.zh: 八戒闻到米袋上的荷叶香，沙僧发现车轮印朝城外的浅水滩去了。
pages.en: Bajie smelled lotus leaf on a grain sack, and Sha found cart tracks leading toward a shallow riverside marsh.
pages.prompt: Bajie examines a harmless torn grain-sack corner near lotus leaves while Sha Wujing points to shallow cart tracks in soft mud; team members investigate carefully, no pursuit danger.

pages.zh: 县令同意先查线索，不扣留任何人。寇员外也请乡邻把猜测收回来。
pages.en: The magistrate agreed to follow the clues and detain no one. Elder Kou asked the neighbors to take back their guesses.
pages.prompt: Create a kind magistrate: middle-aged Chinese official with an oval face, calm dark eyes, neat black mustache, navy-and-cream robes, and a simple black wingless cap. He sits at a low outdoor table listening equally to the team and Elder Kou; no courtroom intimidation or punishment.

pages.zh: 悟空望向芦苇荡：“真相已经留下脚印。我们一起去找，不让无辜的人背着误会。”
pages.en: Wukong looked toward the reeds. "The truth has left footprints. Let us find it together, so no innocent person carries the blame."
pages.prompt: The established team, Elder Kou, and magistrate stand at the edge of a sunlit shallow reed marsh, following gentle cart tracks; Wukong leads with staff upright as a walking stick, suspenseful but safe.
